To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the leadership style of a global sales manager should be based on the cultural environment of the salesperson and 2) the leadership style that is the most effective in a specific cultural environment is the participative style.

global sales managers who use participative leadership styles in collectivistic countries will have higher sales force performance and higher levels of sales force satisfaction than global sales managers who do not use participative leadership.

the most effective leadership styles for sales managers are: (a) participative leadership for salespeople from cultures that are high in individualism; (b) supportive leadership for salespeople in cultures that are high on uncertainty avoidance; (c) directive leadership for salespeople who have a long-term time orientation; (d) achievement-oriented leadership for salespeople whose cultures are high in masculinity; and (e) achievement-oriented leadership in cultures that are low on individualism.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of national culture on the leadership behavior of sales managers.
the impact of national culture on global sales manager leadership style.
the impact of national culture on the relationship between leadership style and salesperson job satisfaction and performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

there is no one best leadership style for global sales managers to use in all situations, and that the appropriate leadership style is dependent on the national culture of the country and the cultural values of the salespeople.
the leadership style of the sales manager is a significant determinant of sales force performance in the global sales environment, with the style used varying according to the national culture.
the leadership styles of sales managers are influenced by the national culture of their salespeople.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
sales manager leadership style is influenced by the culture of the salesperson, but not by the culture of either the sales manager or the country of origin.
global sales managers need to be aware of the cultural differences in their sales force, and that the leadership style used should be based on the cultural characteristics of the sales force members.
global sales managers must be aware of the cultural differences in their markets and be prepared to adapt to those differences in order to be successful in managing their salespeople.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the leadership styles of participative, supportive, and directive can be used in all cultural environments.
global sales managers should be aware that their leadership style can have an impact on their subordinates’ job satisfaction and performance.
the most effective global sales manager leadership style will vary by national cultural setting.
